rule: The PO number must be entered against every line item, not only in the invoice reference field.
Lines must be grouped site-wise (Shamshabad, Medchal, Patancheru), not role-wise.
SAC 998519 must appear on every line, not once in the header.
Invoices are only accepted on the portal between the 1st and 5th of the month. Later uploads sit unprocessed until the next window.
Overtime is payable only against a Meridian OT authorisation number issued by the site manager. Unreferenced OT is struck off.
Workers who exit mid-month are billable only to their last working day; Meridian's gate system is the reference.
Man-days must reconcile to the plant biometric gate register. Yogita's register is authoritative, not Pragati's muster.
Billing cycle runs 26th to 25th, not calendar month. Days after the 25th belong to the next invoice.
Overtime above 1.5x requires prior written approval from the plant head, referenced by approval number.
Service charge is computed on wages only, never on PF/ESI.
A worker absent more than 3 consecutive days is not billable for those days even if on the muster.
The annexure must be in Yogita's own Excel template with gate ID and shift columns.
Uncovered shifts are deducted at Rs 500 per shift as an SLA penalty, applied silently.
Payment terms are 45 days from invoice date, not the 30 days stated on Pragati's invoice.
Festival/holiday double-pay is not accepted unless the store manager pre-approved the shift in writing.
